html:
SMTO-EXE-0165 — The Gateway is missing the software to work with this document

GUID: 65e41856-18bb-5bf5-8f35-31bd4d6afe5b
Slug: office-backend-unavailable
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: office

What happened

  • The computer SMTO is working on doesn't have working software for this kind of file (Word, Excel or PowerPoint). Nothing was read or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. On the computer running the Gateway, run the SMTO installer again from the SMTO folder (for example ./install.sh), using the same account the Gateway runs as. The installer adds the document libraries SMTO needs to open Word, Excel and PowerPoint files.
  2. When no tasks are running on that Gateway, restart the Gateway program on that computer. The Gateway only picks up newly installed software after it restarts.
  3. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways, expand that Gateway and check that Capabilities lists office_word, office_excel or office_powerpoint. These entries show the Gateway can now handle that file type.
  4. Select Refresh targets in the conversation's Target menu, then ask SMTO to work on the document again. Nothing was changed the first time, so it is safe to try again once the software is in place.

What success looks like

  • The Gateway's Capabilities list includes the matching office entry and SMTO opens the document.

If it still fails

  • Send the installer's output and the copied error details to the person who installed SMTO. Repair the existing installation; don't delete the Gateway, its pairing or its settings. Turning on a Skill doesn't install this software.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The selected Gateway's Office backend for this format (python-docx, openpyxl or python-pptx) is missing, failed installer import/round-trip verification, or is installed at a version outside the supported range (office.backend_unavailable).

What this means

  • Office backend readiness found a failed import/verification or an installed document-library version outside the supported compatibility range. Office workers treat document content as untrusted data and never execute macros or formulas. Publication creates a separate output under existing File policy; retain revision and effect facts before any new write.

Why this can happen

  • Office backend readiness found a failed import/verification or an installed document-library version outside the supported compatibility range.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect format-specific Office capability facts and installed backend verification on the selected Gateway.

How to fix it

  • From the matching checkout on the Gateway host, rerun ./install.sh (server plus local Gateway) or the Gateway-only installer (./src/gateway_agent/install.sh on Linux, ./src/gateway_macos/install.sh on macOS, .\src\gateway_windows\install.ps1 on Windows) as the Gateway's own OS account. Alternatively install the extra into the Gateway environment (python -m pip install "aor-runtime[office]"; supported: python-docx>=1.2,<2, openpyxl>=3.1.5,<4, python-pptx>=1.0.2,<2). Then restart the Gateway, confirm office_word/office_excel/office_powerpoint under Settings › Setup › Gateways, and refresh targets before a new task.
  • Reinstall or repair the affected Gateway by rerunning its supported installer on that Gateway host. After installation succeeds and active work is settled, restart the Gateway and refresh its metadata.
  • From the matching repository checkout, run ./install.sh for the server and local Gateway, or use the Gateway-only installer: ./src/gateway_agent/install.sh on Linux, ./src/gateway_macos/install.sh on macOS, or .\src\gateway_windows\install.ps1 on Windows. Run it as the account used by the Gateway so its environment and browser caches are repaired.
  • After active jobs and uncertain operations are reconciled, restart the affected Gateway. Restart the server too if the shared installer updated it. Refresh Gateway metadata before starting a new task.
  • Require the installer dependency audit and local functional checks to pass, then verify the selected Gateway advertises the required capability. Start a new task after refreshing metadata; existing tasks retain their captured capability snapshot.

Retry and execution caution

  • Require the installer dependency audit and local functional checks to pass, then verify the selected Gateway advertises the required capability. Start a new task after refreshing metadata; existing tasks retain their captured capability snapshot. Inspect prior execution receipts before repeating work.

How to verify the fix

  • The affected Word, Excel or PowerPoint backend passes readiness under the supported installation.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.
  • Repair the installation in place; do not delete Gateway pairing, credentials, settings, browser profiles or task artifacts.
  • Granting a Skill permission does not install its dependencies.

Technical notes

  • Office workers treat document content as untrusted data and never execute macros or formulas. Publication creates a separate output under existing File policy; retain revision and effect facts before any new write.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
